messages.subject: Undocumented stat_density2d options
parts:
Hi all,

args(stat_density2d)

gives me

function (mapping = NULL, data = NULL, geom = "density2d", position =
"identity",
na.rm = FALSE, contour = TRUE, n = 100, ...)
NULL

and ?stat_density2d says that ... passed on to kde2d. args(kde2d) gives

function (x, y, h, n = 25, lims = c(range(x), range(y)))

Nothing here nor the arguments for geom_contour or stat_contour say
anything about a bin or binwidth argument. And yet this works:

x<-c(seq(0.15,0.4,length.out=30),seq(0.2,0.6,length.out=30),
seq(0.4,0.6,length.out=30))
y<-c(0.55,x[1:29]+0.2*rnorm(29,0.4,0.3),x[31:60]*rnorm(30,0.3,0.1),x[61:90]*rnorm(30,0.4,0.25))
dat<-data.frame(level=c(rep(1, 30),rep(2,30), rep(3,30)), x=x,y=y)

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(dat, aes(x, y, colour=(factor(level)), fill=level))+
geom_point()+
stat_density2d(bins=2)

and indeed the examples for stat_contour show

library(reshape2) # for melt
volcano3d <- melt(volcano)
names(volcano3d) <- c("x", "y", "z")
v <- ggplot(volcano3d, aes(x, y, z = z))
v + stat_contour(bins = 2)
v + stat_contour(bins = 10)

So the question: where is the bin and binwidth argument documented? If
nowhere, shouldn't it be?

Thanks,

Ista
